name: Commerce Repeat Order
description: Lets a customer rebuild a cart from one of their previous Drupal Commerce orders via a link.
project_description: Commerce Repeat Order lets an end user re-order a previous Drupal Commerce order by exposing a single route, /commerce-repeat-order/{commerce_order}, that rebuilds the customer's cart from the items of a prior order. The route is meant to be surfaced as a simple link or button (for example on the order detail page or the user's order history), passing the order id dynamically. A CommerceRepeatOrder controller loads the order, confirms the order belongs to the current user, then either adds the order's items to the existing default cart or replaces the cart, according to a site-wide setting. Only published products are copied; unavailable products are skipped with an optional status message. An OrderCloneEvent is dispatched per item so other modules can react. Requires Commerce and Commerce Cart.
